extracted.name: Real Hummus
extracted.description: This classic hummus recipe is easy to make by blending chickpeas, garlic, tahini, and lemon for a wonderful homemade snack or appetizer.
ingredient_lines: 1 (19 ounce) can garbanzo beans, half the liquid reserved
instruction_lines: Pour chickpeas into the blender, reserving about 1 tablespoon for garnish. Add reserved liquid, lemon juice, tahini, and salt to taste; blend until creamy and well mixed.
Transfer mixture to a medium serving bowl. Drizzle olive oil and sprinkle pepper over the top. Garnish with reserved chickpeas.
